activities.label: Give a grant for the event's general running
activities.description: Funding or in-kind support for genuine medical education.

activities.label: Fund HCP attendance through an educational grant
activities.description: The recipient organisation selects beneficiaries independently.

activities.label: Give a grant supporting the event's faculty
activities.description: Support to the organiser, rather than paying main-programme faculty directly.

activities.label: Hire a satellite symposium speaker
activities.description: Genuine speaker services under a consulting agreement.

activities.label: Send company representatives
activities.description: Company staff attend the event without funding HCP attendance.

activities.label: Buy a booth, advertising or a symposium package
activities.description: Commercial support with defined services in return.

activities.label: Pay an HCP's costs as a delegate or trainee
activities.description: Includes registration, travel, accommodation and other attendance costs.

activities.label: Pay an HCP who provides services
activities.description: Main-programme faculty, booth speakers or company meeting consultants.

activities.label: Organise a company meeting or training
activities.description: Product/procedure education, business meetings or fee-for-service meetings.

activities.label: Provide a meal at a business or scientific meeting
activities.description: Includes a meeting held around a congress; no blanket invitations.

activities.label: Support an event organised by individual HCPs
activities.description: Supplier payments or products where there is no recipient legal entity.

activities.label: Provide an educational or promotional item
activities.description: Also covers prizes, gifts and appreciation items at an event.

activities.label: Provide demonstration products or samples
activities.description: Free products for training, demonstration or familiarisation.

activities.label: Support a proctorship or preceptorship
activities.description: Supervised clinical learning on healthcare organisation premises.

activities.label: Support a charitable or fundraising event
activities.description: Assess the recipient and charitable purpose separately from education.

activities.label: Provide research funding or a royalty arrangement
activities.description: Requires the dedicated research or royalty provisions.

conditions.label: The programme is relevant, educational/business purpose is genuine, and the schedule meets the applicable requirements
Location, season, access, venue and accommodation satisfy the Code criteria
The company does not fund entertainment, social events or guests, or arrange guest expenses
Applicable local laws, professional codes and company requirements have been checked
Required employer notifications, approvals and disclosures will be completed before support/services
A written request or documented initiative, recipient due diligence, purpose/budget and signed agreement are in place
The grant decision is independent of sales and the recipient independently selects HCP beneficiaries without company direction
Funds are restricted to genuine medical education; use will be verified and applicable educational-grant disclosure completed
Services meet a documented legitimate need; the expert is selected for qualifications, with no sales inducement
A signed consulting agreement defines the actual services, fair-market-value fees, expenses and disclosures
Commercial services and price are documented, professional and distinct from educational funding or disguised HCP support
The company has reviewed attendance internally against Code principles, including perception and registration fees
The company controls the event, its content serves the stated legitimate purpose, and trainers/experts are qualified
Hospitality is modest, subordinate to the meeting, within local limits, and excludes luxury lodging and home delivery
Travel/expenses are reasonable, actual and limited to attendance/services; no first class, unjustified extended stays or prospective cash advances
The meal supports a legitimate meeting with a small selected group; it is not a social event or blanket congress invitation
The item has a genuine educational/practice/patient purpose, is not cash, personal-use, requested by an HCP, a life-event gift or an inducement
It is modest within local limits, or a recorded occasional higher-value educational item for an HCO meeting Chapter 8 conditions
No-charge terms, delivery records, reasonable quantities and return/title controls for multiple-use products are documented
The intermediary has risk-based due diligence, Code obligations, training and ongoing oversight

companyApplies.label: Is this a medical-technology interaction subject to the MedTech Europe Code?
companyApplies.help: For member companies and relevant affiliates. If applicability or a membership transition is uncertain, select “I don’t know”.

supportStage.label: What stage is the proposed support at?
options: Planning or a commitment subject to conditions
Signing off or providing the support
supportStage.help: A conditional planning arrangement and actually providing funds or benefits are different stages.

eventType.label: What kind of event or arrangement is this?
options: Company sales, promotional or business meeting
Company advisory board or investigator/services meeting
Purely promotional exhibition without educational sessions
eventType.help: Check who initiates and controls the agenda, who selects attendees, and the actual purpose. CME accreditation or a single sponsor is an indication, not a conclusive test.

format.label: How will the relevant participation take place?
format.help: For a hybrid event, assess each participation component separately.

eventArea.label: Where does the event take place?
options: In the listed MedTech Europe countries
In a country covered by Mecomed
eventArea.help: Annex III lists {countries} and countries covered by Mecomed. Mecomed arrangements require review against the applicable association guidance.

hcpArea.label: Where are the relevant HCPs registered/practising?
options: At least one in the listed MedTech Europe countries
hcpArea.help: Include relevant speakers, delegates and beneficiaries, not just people whose costs the company proposes to pay.

hcoArea.label: Where is the relevant recipient or interacting HCO based?
options: In the listed MedTech Europe countries
hcoArea.help: An HCO in the Code area can bring an interaction into scope even when the event and delegates are elsewhere.

crossBorder.label: Will HCP delegates from different countries attend?
crossBorder.help: Count passive delegates, including poster/abstract presenters. International faculty alone do not determine the delegate audience. A “No” answer will still be checked against a matching CVS record.

recipient.label: Who receives the support?
options: Individual HCP organiser without a legal entity

paymentRoute.label: Where will payment go?
options: Directly to a supplier under the arrangement
To an individual organiser’s personal bank account

packageMixed.label: Does the support package mix educational funding with commercial services?

identifiedBeneficiary.label: Does the company know or effectively determine the individual HCP beneficiaries?
identifiedBeneficiary.help: Includes a one-person HCO or selection criteria so narrow that beneficiaries are identifiable.

intermediary.label: Will an intermediary act for the company in HCP/HCO interactions?

twoAreaCountries.label: Are delegates coming from at least two MedTech Europe-area countries?

localDelegates.label: Are all HCP delegates local to the event’s host country?

handsOnChanged.label: Has the practical hands-on part been cancelled or made virtual?

sessions.label: Check the programme durations
sessions.help: Import or enter the agenda, then review every classification and duration.

procedureSkills.label: Does the programme develop specific clinical procedure skills, rather than focus on products?

streamingFollowed.label: Are streamed/live-surgery demonstrations followed immediately by related hands-on participation?
streamingFollowed.help: Current CVS training guidance requires active practice when treating these demonstrations as practical sessions.

clinicalVenue.label: Is the majority of training in a clinical or suitably equipped simulation environment?

standalone.label: Is this a stand-alone training, rather than attached to a larger conference?

activeStations.label: Do all participants practise actively with appropriate station sizes?
activeStations.help: In principle at most four participants per station, or eight when human cadavers are used. Programme size alone is not decisive.

overlap.label: Is this during or around a third-party educational event in the same approximate location?
overlap.help: Consider both timing and location, including meetings arranged for convenience around a congress.

nonPortable.label: Is travel/accommodation necessary to demonstrate non-portable equipment?

areaBeneficiaries.label: Will this grant benefit attendance of an HCP from the MedTech Europe area?
areaBeneficiaries.help: Annex I footnote 3 concerns HCPs benefiting from an educational grant.

expenses.label: Which costs does the company propose to cover?
expenses.help: Select each proposed payment; each receives its own assessment.

accessRequired.label: Is registration required for access to the contracted speaker services?
accessRequired.help: Use a one-day or prorated registration where possible.

grantAlreadyCovers.label: Does an educational grant already cover the HCP’s attendance or hospitality?

incrementalCongressCosts.label: Would this pay any incremental costs of attendance at the third-party event?

role.label: What is the HCP’s actual role?
options: Company speaker, adviser or investigator providing services
role.help: Faculty provide actual services requiring preparation. A poster or abstract presenter remains a delegate.

identifiableAttendance.label: Does this directly arrange or fund identifiable HCP conference attendance?

clinicalUse.label: Will they be used in patient care?

onHcoPremises.label: Is this genuine supervised clinical learning on HCO premises?
